svg.text: 8 Ø1,450 drivers, 2 powered trucks + lead truck (LT18-20)
1.5 t ballast option incl. in design mass
Coupling height 550 mm ARL, all vehicles.
Two Grade 100 5/8 in safety chains + Crosby G-2130 1 in shackles at every joint.
Brake pipe + 8 bar feed pipe through every vehicle.
Clear 2,000 mm from track CL to fixed objects (K-401).
Overhead: nothing below 4,300 mm ARL within 2,000 of CL.
Egress strip 2,000-3,300 from CL walkable, >= 1 side.
NO RUNNING in gusts > 40 mph; tie down when parked (DECIDED).
PULSIPHER FARMS · LOGANDALE, NEVADA · CHRISTMAS TRAIN (PF-CT)
Units mm unless noted · Z above top of rail · gauge 914.4 · 3rd-angle
Machined: Ra 3.2 · bores H7/H8 as noted · break edges
GD&T ASME Y14.5-2018 · welds AWS A2.4 / D1.1
PULSIPHER FARMS CHRISTMAS TRAIN — PRELIMINARY, NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION UNTIL PE STAMPED
